map.横向放大率（负号表示倒立）。: Lateral magnification (a negative sign means inverted).
map.成像大小与倒正判定。: Determining image size and whether it is upright or inverted.
map.投影/放大系统的像高估算。: Estimating image height in projection and enlargement systems.
map.实像缩放比计算。: Computing the scale ratio of a real image.
map.m=−di/do=−15/30=−0.5。像高为物高一半且倒立（负号）。: m=−di/do=−15/30=−0.5. The image height is half the object height and inverted (negative sign).
map.m=−60/20=−3，放大的倒立实像。: m=−60/20=−3, an enlarged inverted real image.
map.负号代表什么？: What does the negative sign mean?
map.负号表示倒立；正号（虚像）表示正立。: A negative sign indicates an inverted image; a positive sign (a virtual image) indicates upright.
map.横向放大率 m 比较像高/物高，角放大率 M 比较视角，单位与物理意义都不同。: Lateral magnification m compares image height to object height, while angular magnification M compares visual angles; the units and physical meanings differ.
